 Apple's Stock Faces A Post-Earnings Selloff
 Oct 29, 2026, 9:28 AM ET Apple Inc. (AAPL) Stock , AAPL:CA Stock , ZAAP:CA Stock GOOGL , MSFT , GOOG , GOOG:CA , GOOGM , GOOGN , MSFT:CA , ZGOO:CA , ZMSF:CA 14 Comments Mott Capital Management Investing Group Leader Follow Summary
 Apple Inc. is expected to report strong Q4 earnings and revenue growth, with iPhone sales up 15.3% to $56.5 billion.
 Despite bullish options positioning, AAPL faces strong resistance at $355–$360, with limited support until $330, increasing downside risk post-earnings.
 Technical signals, including bearish RSI divergence and consolidation, suggest vulnerability; a break below the uptrend could target $328 or even $315.
 To sustain its rally, AAPL must deliver a beat-and-raise quarter; anything less likely triggers short-term selling pressure.
